summary: MQ-triggered CICS date service (VSAM-MQ variant). Started by an IBM MQ trigger message, it retrieves the triggering queue name via CICS RETRIEVE, opens the input, reply and error MQ queues, reads request messages (a function code + account key), services each request (e.g. a date/account lookup against the account file), and puts a reply message on the reply queue. Errors are written to an error queue. A message-driven integration service rather than batch business logic.

paragraphs.name: 1000-CONTROL
paragraphs.pseudocode: Main driver: clear the queue work areas, open the error queue, and use CICS RETRIEVE to obtain the name of the MQ queue that triggered this transaction (setting the reply queue to 'CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE'). Then open the input queue, loop getting request messages until no more, service each request and put a reply, and finally close the queues and return.

annotations.note: Triggered via CICS RETRIEVE of an MQ trigger message; queue names are environment-specific. Flag MQ/CICS integration for SME review during modernization.

paragraphs.name: 2100-OPEN-ERROR-QUEUE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the MQ error queue so failures can be reported.
branches: IF MQ reason code not OK -> error

paragraphs.name: 2000-OPEN-INPUT-QUEUE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Connect to the queue manager and open the input request queue for reading.
branches: IF MQ reason code not OK -> error
paragraphs.notes: MQCONN + MQOPEN of the input queue.

paragraphs.name: 3000-GET-MESSAGE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Get the next request message from the input queue into the request buffer; when the queue is empty, set the no-more-messages flag. The request contains a function code and an account key.
branches: IF MQ get reason = no-message -> NO-MORE-MSGS

paragraphs.name: 4000-PROCESS-REQUEST
paragraphs.pseudocode: Service the request based on its function code: read the account file for the requested account key and derive the requested date information to return.

annotations.note: Request function/date semantics only partially visible; confirm the exact date-service contract with an SME.

paragraphs.name: 5000-PUT-REPLY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Put the reply message (result of the request) on the reply queue.
branches: IF MQ put reason not OK -> error

paragraphs.name: 6000-CLOSE-QUEUES
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the input, reply and error queues and disconnect from the queue manager.

paragraphs.name: 9000-MQ-ERROR
paragraphs.pseudocode: On any MQ/CICS error, format the failing operation, condition and reason codes and write an error message to the error queue.
